biotools.summary:
J-Express is a browser-based platform for interactive exploration and analysis of multidimensional scientific data. Originally developed for gene expression analysis, J-Express now supports bulk and single-cell RNA-seq workflows, principal component analysis (PCA), correspondence analysis, clustering, heatmaps, feature selection, and visualization of high-dimensional embeddings.

The platform combines interactive visualizations with statistical analysis and optional AI-assisted workflows through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Analyses run locally in the browser, and the application can be used without programming.
